checks: After "is" and before "than", lower is the comparative of magnitude. Lowest/fewest are superlatives, fewer counts discrete things rather than quantifying consumption. Zh-TW keeps idle power and the previous model.

activeQuestion.prompt: The idle power consumption of the new controller is ____ than that of the previous model.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 新控制器的待機耗電量比前一型號____。

options.whyZh: power consumption 是耗電量，程度較低用 lower。
句中有 than，需要比較級 lower。
既是可數最高級，也不符合 than 比較。
fewer 修飾可數數量，不能表達耗電量較低。
